subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent TUI delivery default, and should the canonical surface be `tui.deliver`, an in-TUI setting, or a changed CLI default with explicit opt-out?
rationale: The missing capability is clear, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces and current docs intentionally frame delivery as an explicit launch-time choice.

options.title: Approve persistent TUI default
options.body: Add the chosen canonical default surface with schema/help/docs/tests and explicit CLI flag precedence.

options.title: Keep delivery launch-only
options.body: Leave delivery as an intentional per-session launch flag and close or document the ergonomics request after maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Change the CLI default
options.body: Turn delivery on by default only if maintainers accept the compatibility and outbound-delivery behavior change.

recommendation.title: Approve persistent TUI default
recommendation.body: Add the chosen canonical default surface with schema/help/docs/tests and explicit CLI flag precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: The gateway TUI surface traces to steipete, and the remaining choice is primarily a TUI/default product contract.
